content:
From the technical table, the four nominal wavelengths line up with the four transmit wavelength ranges on the same rows. The module is one SKU with four LAN-WDM lanes at 25.78 Gbps; per-lane max output is +6.5 dBm (footnote 3). Module-level “grey” technology and aggregate 103.12 Gbps / +12.5 dBm are not tied to a single wavelength row, so four lane modes are the evidence-based split.
